import json, hashlib

def load_rows(cid):
    rows=[json.loads(l) for l in open('runs/index.jsonl') if l.strip()]
    out=[]
    for r in rows:
        if r.get('campaign')==cid: out.append(r)
    return out

base=load_rows('agnes-stage-d-baseline-20261010-agent')
cond=load_rows('agnes-stage-d-conditional-integral-20261010-agent')
print('base rows',len(base),'cond rows',len(cond))
# pair by simProfile signature
def sig(r):
    p=r['meta']['sim']['simProfile']
    c=r['meta']['sim'].get('controllerStats',{})
    return json.dumps({'p':p,'sat':c.get('saturatedSteps'),'sup':c.get('integralSuppressedSteps')},sort_keys=True)
bmap={sig(r):r for r in base}
cmap={sig(r):r for r in cond}
allb=allc=True
for k in bmap:
    if k not in cmap: print('missing in cond:',k); allc=False; continue
    rb,rc=bmap[k],cmap[k]
    h1=hashlib.sha256(open('runs/'+rb['csv'],'rb').read()).hexdigest()
    h2=hashlib.sha256(open('runs/'+rc['csv'],'rb').read()).hexdigest()
    eq=h1==h2
    allb&=eq
    print('sat/sup',k.split('"sat"')[1].split(',')[0],k.split('"sup"')[1].split(',')[0],'| byteEqual',eq)
print('all csv byte equal across shared conditions:',allb)
EOF
